review:
A Wild West money-collect game. Money symbols on reels one to four carry 1x–35x, and a collector on reel five scoops them all up.

Collect the jackpot value and you get the Jackpot Reveal: match three for a 50x, 100x, 200x or 1,000x jackpot. Three scatters give eight free spins with more money and collectors, retriggering endlessly. Up to 12,000x, 96.53% RTP. Straightforward collect fun.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
